question: In Linear: Rename the '3D Secure Fallback Plan' document in the Payments team to '3D Secure Fallback Plan — Final'.
final:
I found two documents titled **“3D Secure Fallback Plan”** in the **Payments team**:

- [3D Secure fallback document](https://linear.app/northwind/document/ab3ad48d-00b3-4e59-8d74-276d7cb343c2) — covers failed checkout payments, retry sequencing, and exemption flags.
- [Token refresh document](https://linear.app/northwind/document/60e896bc-f6fd-4074-82ad-8105d31a7e94) — despite the title, its content covers mobile token refresh.

Should I rename the first one to **“3D Secure Fallback Plan — Final”**?
